name: Johnson
story: A super cyborg who can transform into a car and lead his teammates into battle.

skills.name: Electro Airbag
skills.desc: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300 (+700% Total Physical Defense) shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.

skills.name: Impact Wrench
skills.desc: Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120 (+220% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

skills.name: Electromagnetic Waves
skills.desc: Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 120 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, reducing their Movement Speed and Magic Defense by 10% (stacks up to 3 times) for 2s. While his shield is raised, Johnson can perform Basic Attacks and cast skills.

skills.name: Full Throttle
skills.desc: Passive: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%. Active: Johnson transforms into a car. Nearby allied heroes can use Hop In to ride with him (only 1 at a time). When the car hits an enemy hero, it explodes and deals 300 (+240% Total Physical Defense)–450 (+360% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5–1s (scales with driving time). It also creates an electrified zone at the location that continuously deals 60 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies within. Johnson's location is revealed to enemies for 3s when he casts this skill.
